lines.text: Servants found Abishag the Shunammite for the aged David, and Adonijah, son of Haggith, declared, "I will be king!"
Adonijah conferred with Joab and Abiathar, then sacrificed at En-rogel and invited his brothers but not Solomon.
Nathan told Bathsheba to remind David of his oath that Solomon would reign, and promised to confirm her words.
David ordered Solomon set on his own mule, and Benaiah anointed him with oil from the tabernacle at Gihon.
Adonijah's guests scattered in terror, and Adonijah took hold of the horns of the ark until Solomon sent him home.
